sources.title: Linear – The system for product development
sources.description: Purpose-built for planning and building products with AI agents.

sources.title: Pricing – Linear
sources.description: Use Linear for free with your whole team. Upgrade to enable unlimited issues, enhanced security controls, and additional features.

sources.title: Concepts – Linear Docs
sources.description: Linear is built around a few core concepts that provide rails for your organization’s work, from a simple bug fix to a company-wide initiative.

sources.title: Start Guide – Linear Docs
sources.description: Linear is the product development system for teams and agents. This guide helps you move quickly from new workspace to getting work done.

sources.title: Teams – Linear Docs
sources.description: Create teams in your workspace to organize different types of work functions.

sources.title: Projects – Linear Docs
sources.description: Create Projects for features or large units of work.

sources.title: Triage – Linear Docs
sources.description: Manage issues created by other teams and customer support integrations.

sources.title: Changelog – Linear
sources.description: New updates and improvements to Linear.

sources.title: Linear Developers
sources.description: Learn about building apps and integrations for Linear using the GraphQL API and TypeScript SDK.

sources.title: Integrations – Linear
sources.description: Enhance your Linear workspace with hand-picked integrations.

sources.title: Security – Linear
sources.description: Everything in Linear is designed to keep your work safe and secure. Because your business is nobody else’s business.

sources.title: We're hiring – Linear
sources.description: We are crafting the tool for teams who care about quality. Join us on our mission!

sources.title: Linear Mobile – Available for iOS and Android
sources.description: Move product work forward, no matter where you are. Available for iOS and Android.

sources.title: Linear Method – Practices for building
sources.description: The quality of a product is driven by both the talent of its creators and how they feel while they’re crafting it. To bring back the right focus, these are the foundational and evolving ideas Linear is built on.

sources.title: An AI product system for modern enterprises
sources.description: Linear gives teams and agents shared context for planning and building products at scale.

sources.title: Cycles – Linear Docs
sources.description: Cycles are a practice to keep up your team's momentum, similar to commonly used agile-flavored sprints.

sources.title: Issues – Linear Docs
sources.description: Issues are the core unit of work and can represent anything a team needs to track, like bugs, feature work, follow-up tasks, or internal requests.
